theme_central: A divine case study of a community in crisis: the Battle of the Trench at the center, framed by the social reforms that address its deep causes and consequences.
sources_note: Detailed and precisely sourced division (tafsirzilal.wordpress.com, Prologue Surah 33): 1-3, 4-5, 9-27, 28-34, 35, 36-40, 41-48.

branches.title: Opening instructions
branches.resume: Obey the revelation, rely on Allah; believers closer to one another than by blood ties.

children.t: Obey the revelation, rely on Allah rather than the hypocrites
Believers closer to one another; the covenant of the prophets

branches.title: Social reform: abolition of adoption
branches.resume: Zihar repudiated, calling adopted children by the name of their true father.

children.t: Abolition of pre-Islamic adoption, truth of lineage confirmed

branches.title: The Battle of the Trench
branches.resume: Siege of Medina, reactions of the believers and the hypocrites, miraculous victory by the wind.

children.t: Siege of Medina, fear of the wavering, cynicism of the hypocrites
The Prophet, an excellent example; victory through the wind and unseen armies

branches.title: The Prophet's wives
branches.resume: Choice offered between worldly life and Allah, status of the Mothers of the believers, spiritual equality in the ten qualities.

children.t: Choice offered to the Prophet's wives, status as Mothers of the believers
The ten qualities leading to forgiveness, equal for men and women

branches.title: Marriage with Zaynab
branches.resume: Breaking of a social taboo, confirmation that Muhammad is not the father of any grown man among them.

children.t: Marriage with Zaynab, taboo of adoption definitively abolished

branches.title: Mission of the Prophet
branches.resume: Witness, warner, light; specific rules concerning the Prophet's wives.

children.t: The Prophet: witness, announcer, warner, radiant light
Rule of divorce before consummation, categories lawful specifically for the Prophet

branches.title: The hijab, due respect, closing
branches.resume: Verse of the hijab, not to offend the Prophet, the veil of the believing women, the trust assumed by man.

children.t: Verse of the hijab, etiquette at the Prophet's home, respect due to Allah and His messenger
Not to slander the believers, command of the veil (jilbab) for believing women
Question about the Hour, regret of those who wrongly followed their leaders
The trust (al-amana) offered to the heavens and the earth, assumed by man
